intro: Denalan's Earth is an errand running south from the settlement of Dolanaar to the tranquil waters of Lake Al'Ameth. Syral Bladeleaf asks travelers to hand-deliver a delayed shipment of rare, enriched soil to her botanical colleague, Denalan, who studies the boughs and flora of the new World Tree.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Are you heading to the south? To Lake Al'Ameth? If so, then I have a task I might ask of you...

My colleague Denalan has a camp along the eastern end of the lake, where he is studying and experimenting on the plant life of Teldrassil. He requested a package of rare earths from Darnassus and it was late, only recently arriving here in Dolanaar.
Can you take the package to him?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, it's here! I have waited for this rare earth for quite some time. I hope it's still fresh...
Thank you for bringing it to me, friend. You are a traveler who is generous with their time.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
